title.en: Guide every Today’s Sprint step with Check and Continue
title.zh: 以检查与继续引导今日速成每一步

purpose.en: Make Today’s Sprint clearer and more effective with explicit answer feedback, scored repetition, ordered vocabulary, cross-language sentence building, and member resume support.
purpose.zh: 通过明确答题反馈、评分跟读、词汇排序、跨语言组句及会员续学，让今日速成更清晰有效。

en: Use explicit Check, feedback, and Continue states across vocabulary, reading, listening, writing, and speaking.
Add normal and slow model audio plus three scored follow-me attempts.
Show new-word or previous-mistake status, difficulty, and frequency.
Build sentence answers in a language different from the prompt or audio language.
Resume signed-in members from D1 while every anonymous picker entry starts a fresh run; extending the timer preserves the active run.
zh: 在词汇、阅读、听力、写作与口语中使用明确的检查、反馈和继续状态。
增加正常与慢速示范，以及三次评分跟读。
显示新词或以前错过状态、难度与常用度。
组句答案始终使用与题目或音频不同的语言。
登录会员从 D1 续学；匿名用户每次从选择器进入都新开一轮，延长时间则保留当前轮次。

en: Today’s Sprint UI and API, sentence builder, vocabulary SmartCard practice, and D1 Sprint runs
zh: 今日速成界面与 API、挑词组句、词汇智慧卡练习及 D1 速成记录

en: Select words by lowest difficulty and then highest frequency.
Store bounded member checkpoints in additive Sprint-run columns.
Keep anonymous progress only in the active React session and never in cookies or browser storage.
Label source and answer languages for cross-language sentence tasks.
zh: 先按最低难度、再按最高常用度选择词汇。
通过速成记录的增量字段保存受限会员检查点。
匿名进度只存在当前 React 会话，不写 Cookie 或浏览器存储。
为跨语言组句明确标记题目语言与答案语言。

en: Pass targeted Sprint, SmartCard, and vocabulary tests; TypeScript; D1 validation; production build; sensitive-data scan; policy and architecture audits.
Verify the deployed anonymous flow and responsive Check/Continue states in a real user-facing browser.
zh: 通过速成、智慧卡与词汇定向测试、TypeScript、D1 校验、生产构建、敏感数据扫描、政策及架构审计。
部署后在真实用户浏览器核验匿名流程及响应式检查/继续状态。

en: Local browser rendering cannot exercise D1 because the standalone production preview has no local binding; final interaction acceptance is performed after the GitHub Actions Cloudflare deployment.
Four pre-existing unrelated contract failures remain in Chinese metadata, Clerk navigation, password settings, and a learning-path source assertion.
zh: 独立生产预览没有本地 D1 绑定，无法在本机浏览器运行完整流程；最终交互验收在 GitHub Actions 部署 Cloudflare 后进行。
中文元数据、Clerk 跳转、密码设置及一项学习路径源码断言仍有四个与本次无关的既有契约失败。

en: Use SmartLingo’s own brand and learning model while applying proven single-focus exercise cadence; do not copy Duolingo characters or assets.
Preserve Clerk, Cloudflare, AI gateway, commerce, and site-owned data boundaries.
zh: 采用成熟的单题聚焦节奏，同时保留 SmartLingo 自有品牌与学习模型，不复制 Duolingo 角色或素材。
保持 Clerk、Cloudflare、AI 网关、商业及站点自有数据边界。
